strategies.name: orb_15m_immediate_breakout

entry_sequence.action: I'm here on a 15-minute chart, and I set my time zone to New York. So, that's UTC minus 4.
I then look for the 9:30 candle, which is the market open in New York, and that's this green candle here.
Once I've got that, I'm going to mark out the high and the low. So, I mark the high and then do the same thing with the low. This gives me my opening range.
After that, I'm just waiting for a candle to break out through this range.

There are different ways to do this, and I know that some people will enter as soon as the price is broken, like on this green wick up here. But I prefer to wait for the candle to actually break through and then close above.
So, in this case, my signal is this candle here because it's the first one to actually break out and then close outside of that range.
I then enter at the open of the next one.

confluences.description: I don't trade after the 12:00 candle, which would be here. So that would be my cut off for entering a trade.
I also don't trade ranges that are either too small or too big based on the recent ATR.

strategies.stop: the stop loss goes at the bottom of the range

targets.description: I target 1.5 to one reward to risk

instrument_classification.reason: Opening-range breakout demonstrated on the S&P 500 ("I have back tested 5 years of S&P 500 data"); a pure price-action mechanic with no options Greeks or strikes.
